name: Nandi Getiet
body:
NANDI GETIET
CR 9

XP 6,400
CE Medium magical beast
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 14, flat-footed 19 (+4 Dex, +9 natural), touch 11, flat-footed 17 (+1 Dex, +7 natural)
hp 114 (12d10+48)
Fort +12, Ref +12, Will +7; Immune Fear

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee bite +19 (2d6+7), 2 claw +19 (1d4+7/19-20 x3 plus rend)
Special Attacks blood frenzy, terrifying roar, pounce, rend (2 claws, 1d4+10)

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 18, Con 18, Int 11, Wis 17, Cha 13
Base Atk +12; CMB +19 (+23 overrun); CMD 33 (35 vs. overrun)
Feats Blind Fight, Greater Overrun, Improved Critical (claw), Improved Initiative, Improved Overrun, Power Attack
Skills Intimidate +13, Perception +12, Stealth +13
Languages Common
SQ brain eater, keen smell
Gear None

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Brain Eater (Ex)

If the nandi’s attack leaves a creature dead or dying, as a swift action it devours the creature’s brain, killing it instantly (DC 20 Fort negates for a dying creature). The nandi gains the one of the following benefits of its choice, lasting a number of minutes equal to the target’s Hit Dice, based on the type of creature slain. If multiple could apply, it chooses one.

Animal: Regains hit points equal to the victim’s Hit Dice, and the DC of its Terrifying Roar increases by 3.

Arcane Spellcaster: Regains hit points equal to 1d4 times the victim’s Hit Dice and gains +5 on saving throws against spells.

Divine Spellcaster: Regains Hit Points equal to 1d8 times the victim’s Hit Dice.

Fiend: Regains 1d4 hit points per Hit Dice the victim had, but is confused (as the confusion spell) for 1d4 rounds.

Humanoid: Regains 1d4 hit points per Hit Dice the victim had and enters a rage, gaining a +2 morale bonus on melee attack and damage rolls, Strength checks, and Will saves, and DR 5/-. If already at full hit points, the nandi gains 20 temporary hit points.

Undead: Takes 1d4 damage and is sickened for 1d4 rounds. Additionally, it detects as undead for spells such as detect undead but is not treated as undead otherwise.

Blood Frenzy (Ex)

The nandi gains +2 on melee attack rolls against creatures that don’t have all their hit points.

Keen Smell (Ex)

The nandi’s sense of smell is so acute it detects creatures currently taking bleed damage or below half their hit points as if it had blindsight.

Terrifying Roar (Su)

Once every 1d4 rounds, the nandi can release a blood-curdling roar causing all creatures within 30 feet hearing it to become frightened for 1d4 rounds (DC 17 Will negates).

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure none

The nandi is a larger and more vicious cousin of the common getiet. It is hulking, bestial predator with a grotesque, misshapen body covered in coarse fur. Its twisted limbs are unnaturally strong, and its face resembles a nightmarish combination of ape and hyena. Known as the “Nandi Bear” in some regions, the nandi is feared for its insatiable hunger and feral savagery.

Created through cursed magic or born of blighted lands, these monstrosities bring ruin wherever they tread.
